summary: Approved as readable, behavior-validated unmatched C++ with zero matching-source byte credit.
reason: Source preserves the x86 cdecl ABI, dispatch offsets, single callback, 32-bit result comparison, -10 fallback, and callback side effects. Independently verified all 40 reference bytes against immutable Game.exe and passed 100,000 randomized differential cases. Documented backend, fault, and exception limitations remain; sampled validation does not establish all-input equivalence.
